io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.longDescription: StructureClerk answers what an AI agent is allowed to do, before it acts. It compiles regulatory mapping — data protection across 192 jurisdictions, AI governance in 18, cybersecurity in 5 — into deterministic, rule-based decisions: ALLOW, APPROVE (human approval required), DENY (reserved for humans) or ESCALATE (below the confidence threshold). Every decision cites the applicable frameworks at framework level, and ships with an Ed25519 signature and a position in an append-only chained log, so any third party can verify it without trusting the issuer. Decisions are advisory: StructureClerk decides, your infrastructure enforces.
